analysis.overall: A manageable afternoon and steady evening turned into a challenging morning, dominated by a prolonged, stubborn low following an early site change.

events.title: Late afternoon spike
events.description: Glucose crested at 221 mg/dL following back-to-back meal boluses and stacked corrections before heading back down.

events.title: Smooth evening coast
events.description: Insulin delivered around dinner smoothly brought readings back down into a steady target range around 85–95 mg/dL.

events.title: Midnight rise
events.description: Glucose drifted up to 172 mg/dL around midnight, taking several small correction doses over two hours to settle.

events.title: Post-site change drop
events.description: Shortly after a 5:38 AM site change and multiple small corrections, glucose turned sharply downward into low territory.

events.title: Stubborn morning low
events.description: Glucose lingered between 54–65 mg/dL for hours amidst intermittent pump connection loss before finally recovering after 1:00 PM.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be mindful of stacking micro-corrections immediately following a new site change, as increased absorption can trigger extended lows.
